macro.text: Dow and S&P 500 slipped into correction as Nasdaq posted its worst week since 2020
Fed officials kept hitting the airwaves even as new chair Warsh pushed for less talk
US chip export policy to China remains unchanged, Treasury Secretary says after Trump-Xi talks
Gasoline prices fell 75 cents from this year's peak ahead of Thanksgiving travel
ECB handed key roles to France and Germany, with Spain set to take the presidency

corporate.note: Mixed fiscal Q3 results as Old Navy turnaround shows progress, new Athleta CEO named
Stock plunged 14% on the week, its worst stretch since 2008, slipping to 4th most valuable company
Zscaler jumped 18% on a report CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire the security vendor
Stock shrugged off GTA6 hype, investors not sharing in the blockbuster buzz
Anthropic shares slid after IPO but held above offer price as billions in locked-up shares loom
Analysts flagged cheap valuations on memory names as a red flag of peak pricing, not a bargain

frontPage.watch: Watch whether the AI-chip selloff stabilizes and any fresh Fed speak shifts rate-cut odds.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3744 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.839 + 0.973×ln(VIX) + 0.315×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
